macros.name: algorithmref
macros.doc: Used to refer to an algorithm or multiple algorithms.

macros.name: appendixref
macros.doc: Used to refer to an appendix or multiple appendices.

macros.name: axiomref
macros.doc: Used to refer to an axiom or multiple axioms.

macros.name: corollaryref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a corollary or multiple corollaries.

macros.name: definitionref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a definition or multiple definitions.

macros.name: equationref
macros.doc: Used to refer to an equation or multiple equations.

macros.name: exampleref
macros.doc: Used to refer to an example or multiple examples.

macros.name: figureref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a figure or multiple figures.

macros.name: includeteximage
macros.doc: If your image file is made up of LaTeX code (e.g. tikz commands) the file can be included using \includeteximage.

macros.name: lemmaref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a lemma or multiple lemmas.

macros.name: mailto
macros.doc: This will typeset the given email address in a typewriter font.

macros.name: remarkref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a remark or multiple remarks.

macros.name: sectionref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a section or sections.

macros.name: set
macros.doc: In addition to the commands provided by amsmath, the jmlrutils package also provides the \set command which can be used to typeset a set.

macros.name: subfigref
macros.doc: Used to refer to sub-figures without the main figure number, e.g. (a) or (b).

macros.name: subfigure
macros.doc: This makes a sub-figure where 〈contents〉 denotes the contents of the sub-figure.

macros.name: subtabref
macros.doc: Used to refer to sub-tables without the main table number, e.g. (a) or (b).

macros.name: tableref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a table or multiple tables.

macros.name: theorembodyfont
macros.doc: This sets the font declarations used in the body of the theorem.

macros.name: theoremheaderfont
macros.doc: This sets the font declarations used for the theorem title.

macros.name: theorempostheader
macros.doc: This indicates what should occur at the end of the title.

macros.name: theoremref
macros.doc: Used to refer to a theorem or multiple theorems.

macros.name: theoremsep
macros.doc: This indicates what to put between the header and the body of the environment.

envs.name: algorithm
envs.doc: Enumerated textual algorithms can be displayed using the algorithm environment.

envs.name: altdescription
envs.doc: In addition to the standard description environment, the jmlr class also provides the altdescription environment. This has an argument that should be the widest label used in the list.
